title: The intracellular Ca2+ sensitivity of transmitter release in glutamatergic neocortical boutons | Science
content: Synaptotagmin-1 (Syt1) and Syt2 are the main calcium (Ca2+) sensors triggering synchronous release in the brain. In this work, we studied the mechanisms mediating Syt1-triggered release from neocortical synapses. We measured the Ca2+ dependency of ...
